title: 06 · Profiles — the fourth signal
description: The fourth signal. Still alpha: there is no Go profiling SDK, so this demo pushes runtime/pprof output itself.

options.content:
### Rung 4 signal — continuous profiling
A 5-second CPU profile, captured back to back, forever. Hit `localhost:8006/work` and the hot frame below becomes `crunchNumbers` → `sha256.block`.

**Width is time, depth is only nesting.** Look for the widest frame with nothing above it — that is where the CPU actually went.

panels.description: How the profile is captured and pushed, and why that is done by hand.

panels.title: CPU flame graph — demo6-profiles
panels.description: A 5-second CPU profile, captured back to back. One frame, sha256.blockSHA2, holds about half the self time.

options.content:
### If this is empty
Pyroscope takes **10 seconds to 2 minutes** to make a pushed profile queryable, and the first profile for a new service is the slowest. Keep a load loop running:

```
while true; do curl -s localhost:8006/work > /dev/null; done
```
